**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

My dear [Miss Smith](../persons.html#263),

I hope you and the Incurable List are safe together somewhere![^2] I had no list of my own so I asked a friend to send you hers, and owing to some blundering of mine I really do not know whether she sent it to Wilden manor or to Charlton.

Will you kindly when you have looked it over return it addressed

[Miss Jacob](../persons.html#749)
Crawley Rectory
Winchester

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: Black-edged paper.

[^2]: The \'incurable list\' was evidently a list of candidates for admission to an asylum; perhaps either the [Home for Incurable and Infirm Women](../others.html#26) or the [Royal Hospital for Incurables](../others.html#37).
